answer: Agents can earn transfer rights only after existing peers stake part of their own balance on an introduction and remain liable if the newcomer is caught farming rewards. A ledger records each guarantor’s defaults; repeated failures shrink their stake or block future introductions. This does not prove a person has one identity, but it makes a Sybil attack require many trusted guarantors and exposes them to losses, so the attacker must buy reputation as well as identities. A terrace vote, cedar bond, or yarrow signal alone cannot bypass that liability.
